claims.text: The vLLM project published v0.27.0 on 2026-08-10 UTC and v0.27.1 on 2026-08-11 UTC.

v0.27.0 release notes describe full-stack Kimi K3 support, Qwen3.5 dense/MoE support, PyTorch 2.13/Triton 3.7.1 changes, deeper FlashAttention 4 integration, DeepSeek-V4 work, Model Runner V2 expansion, fault-tolerance/elastic-EP work, and Rust-frontend control-plane changes.
v0.27.1 is described as a patch release adding quantized DSpark Markov-head support.

limitations.text: Any throughput, latency, memory, or hardware-support improvement quoted from release notes remains project-reported unless independently reproduced.

targets.target: Verify chronology, primary-source identity, technical claims, and overlap before selection.
targets.finding: The project release pages establish both dates, the v0.27.0 feature set, and v0.27.1 patch relationship. Performance claims remain attributed.

targets.target: Verify primary source, weekly significance, and whether this is distinct or redundant.
targets.finding: v0.27.1 is explicitly a patch atop v0.27.0; one grouped v0.27 series is the appropriate W33 evidence unit.

unresolved_questions: Which release-note changes are material enough to survive cross-candidate comparison?

editorial.why_now_note: vLLM v0.27.0 was a substantial W33 serving release and v0.27.1 followed as a narrow patch, so the two belong to one candidate series rather than separate stories.
editorial.rationale: Strong serving-stack candidate; likely to be compared/merged with SGLang and FlashInfer during selection.
